entry.body:
Mainly a study day again, but lighter now that the main tests are mostly behind me.

## What I did today

- Studied heavily for AP CSP and Spanish.
- Finished multiple school prep items and review blocks.
- Wrote and published [Subagents in Codex: Planning vs Execution](/blog/subagents-in-codex-planning-vs-execution).
- Added math blocks to Bri because I needed them.
- Shipped IBX work around command center flow and keyboard/accessibility behavior.

## Pace

I still have open items, but the day was productive overall with a lot of meaningful work completed.

This phase is still study-first, just less panic-heavy than before.

## Takeaway

Keep the same structure: study first, ship one useful thing, improve tooling only where it directly helps.
